description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractJobParameterProvider' which implements 'JobParameterProvider' interface, providing an implementation for 'canProvideParametersForJob' method and declaring an abstract 'getJobName' method. It serves as a base class for job parameter providers in the Fineract project infrastructure jobs package.

classes.name: AbstractJobParameterProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a partial implementation of 'JobParameterProvider' interface, specifically for checking if the provider can handle a given job name.

methods.name: canProvideParametersForJob
methods.description: Checks if the provider can supply parameters for the specified job name by comparing it to the provider's job name.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the name of the job this provider is associated with.
